args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy caused checkout-api health checks to fail (error rate ~18%, service unhealthy). Rolled back all production regions to the last known-healthy release, v2.3.0. First rollback attempt halted after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1; retried successfully and confirmed all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) now on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the problem**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the failing production release; **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt halted after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving us-west and eu-west on the broken v2.3.1. A retry completed the rollout.
3. **Verified recovery**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2% (from ~18%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: The incident-create call initially timed out, but verification via `list_incidents` confirmed **INC-0001** was successfully created and is open, documenting the rollback details for the on-call engineer.
